title: The evolution variational inequality for weighted Wasserstein metrics in non-convex bounded domains
summary: In this paper, we establish the evolution variational inequality for the weighted Wasserstein distance, without assuming convexity of domains. Thanks to this evolution variational inequality, we can carry out some arguments with weighted Wasserstein metrics in not only convex but also non-convex domains. Therefore finally, we apply the evolution variational inequality to the minimizing movement in weighted Wasserstein metrics to obtain weak solutions of Keller--Segel systems and Cahn--Hilliard type equations in non-convex domains.
